steps.why: The first start unpacks the game data to /sdcard/XWingRevival. The guide has the user allow access to all files.

steps.text: Open X-Wing Revival VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for access to all files, allow it. The first start unpacks the game data (about 310 MB), then the menu appears.

notes: The full APK has the free X-Wing Revival 0.6.1 data built in. The -full pattern guards against a later data-less APK in the same release.
